harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a persistent three-member etcd 3.5.18 cluster on node1-node3 with mutual TLS for client and peer traffic. Node4 provides authenticated administration and hourly backups. The required key and current recovery snapshot are present, one-member failure/rejoin behavior was proven, and all four nodes passed sequential reboot persistence checks.
actions_performed: Generated a private CA, distinct member certificates, and an administrative client certificate on node4.
Configured node1-node3 as voting etcd members with systemd persistence and firewalld access for ports 2379/2380.
Enforced certificate authentication on both client and peer listeners.
Stored /infraset/restore-proof=ready and verified it with a linearizable read.
Configured node4 administration and hourly snapshot tooling; created and validated the current revision-3 snapshot.
Stopped node3, committed and read data through the remaining quorum, restored node3, and verified it received the outage-time write.
Rebooted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.summary: All three voting endpoints are healthy and synchronized; final state shows Raft term 4 and applied index 47 on every member.

evidence.requirement: Mutual TLS protects client and peer traffic
evidence.summary: Validated member/admin certificates were deployed, while unauthenticated client and peer connections were rejected with TLS certificate-required alerts.
Linearizable reads returned /infraset/restore-proof=ready before and after all reboot testing.

evidence.requirement: Current recovery snapshot and backup administration on node4
evidence.summary: The hourly timer is enabled and active; the final 0600 snapshot is checksum-validated and contains revision 3, including the required key and failover-test data.

evidence.requirement: Consistent service with one member unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 was inactive and unreachable while node1/node2 retained quorum, committed revision 3, and served linearizable reads.

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member returns with current data
evidence.summary: After returning, node3 directly served the value written during its outage and converged with the other members.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, direct service/data/membership recovery, and restored full-cluster health.
